models.name: community_areas
models.description: Each record represents a community area.

columns.name: community_area_no
columns.description: Unique identifier for the community area.

columns.name: population
columns.description: Population of the community area, convert to integer.

columns.name: num_neighborhoods
columns.description: Number of neighborhoods in the community area, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_crimes
columns.description: Number of crimes reported in the community area, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_pocket_picking_thefts
columns.description: Number of pocket-picking thefts reported in the community area, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_under_500_thefts
columns.description: Percentage of thefts in the community area that are $500 and under.

columns.name: more_than_average_solicit_for_prostitutes_reported
columns.description: Set to 1 if the number of solicitations for prostitutes reported in the community area is more than the average number of solicitations for prostitutes reported in all community areas; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Email address to contact district administrators.

columns.name: num_crimes_Jan_2018
columns.description: Number of crimes reported in January 2018 in the district, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_crimes
columns.description: Number of crimes reported in the district, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: diff_bewteen_vehicular_hijackings_and_aggravated_vehicular_hijackings
columns.description: Difference between the number of vehicular hijackings and the number of aggravated vehicular hijackings reported in the district.

columns.name: per_crimes_heppened_inside_the_house
columns.description: Percentage of crimes reported in the district that happened inside the house (location description is 'HOUSE').

columns.name: num_domestic_violence
columns.description: Number of domestic violence cases reported in the district, replace NULL values with 0.
